_template_note: Template for outputs/pesn/v542_backbone_50k/audits/parity_certificate.json (Oracle §1.5). Forward-migration certificate ONLY — it does NOT prove training comparability and is NOT evidence for E0 reuse (that is the separate a0_reuse_decision record). 6 checkpoints ALL REQUIRED with source_tier/training_updates pinned per row (fix-5 C3): 3 V541 E0 (S17/S29/S43, MAIN evidence = runs/ 37,900-update final, source_tier=v541_e0_runs_final_37900) + 3 V53MP C (S17/S29/S43, AUXILIARY evidence = outputs/pesn/v53mp/ S3 formal 20k-tier 15,400-update checkpoint, source_tier=v53mp_20k_s3_formal_15400_auxiliary — NOT 37,900, NOT under runs/, NOT smoke); smoke and non-pinned checkpoints are FORBIDDEN; assets located + SHA-pinned by the read-only lane 2026-10-30 (6/6 required). PASS is decided by CPU bitwise equality; max_abs_diff is recorded but not decisive.

asset_policy.smoke_paths_rejected_note: outputs/pesn/v541_embed_50k/smoke/** 路径 (200-update smoke checkpoint) 永不作为 parity 资产; 资产分层 (fix-5 C3, 取代旧「必须 runs/ 37,900 final」绝对措辞): V541 E0 主证据 = runs/ 下 37,900-update final checkpoint (source_tier=v541_e0_runs_final_37900, training_updates=37900); V53MP C 辅助证据 = outputs/pesn/v53mp/ 下 S3 formal 20k-tier 15,400-update checkpoint (source_tier=v53mp_20k_s3_formal_15400_auxiliary, training_updates=15400; 非 37,900、不在 runs/、非 smoke); smoke 与非钉死 (non-pinned) checkpoint 一律禁止

load_audit.rule: strict-audit mapping: read file SHA-256 + payload['model']; apply frozen w_v mapping; missing/unexpected/shape_mismatch/dtype_mismatch ALL empty; assert backbone.w_v.weight is move_decoder.w_v.weight (same tensor); load_state_dict(strict=True); per-key torch.equal(source, target) after load

real_batch_parity.rule: same CPU bitwise on real inner-val batches; fixture pass + real-batch fail => data-dependent boundary bug (empty edges, degK=0, key without in-edges) must be diagnosed, never waived

gpu_tolerance.hard_caps_note: atol=1e-6 / rtol=1e-5 是硬上限 (hard caps); 任何 run-to-run 地板规则都不得放宽该容差 (no tolerance relaxation)
gpu_tolerance.legacy_floor_rule: run legacy twice first to measure the run-to-run floor; the floor is DIAGNOSTIC ONLY — GPU pass/fail is decided solely by the hard caps (max_abs_diff <= atol AND rel_diff <= rtol); if the measured run-to-run floor exceeds the hard cap => GPU parity is INCONCLUSIVE and cannot count as pass evidence; CPU bitwise equality remains the decisive evidence; tolerances are NEVER relaxed either way

evaluator_parity.rule: load E0 checkpoint into V542 A0; recompute H2/H3 inner-val metrics with the V542 evaluator; require bitwise equality or <=1e-9 vs V541 archived metrics (evaluator is deterministic)
